Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the data from the WebSurfer and concluded that Theudebert I's father was Theodoric the Great, when reliable sources explicitly indicated that his father was Theuderic I. The Planner misinterpreted the extracted information, as Theodoric the Great was not mentioned in any of the initial sources provided by the WebSurfer. This error could be attributed to over-reliance on unfamiliar variant readings or incomplete validation against earlier steps that clearly referenced Theuderic I as the father of Theudebert I and Wisigard's father-in-law.
